svg.title: Measured qualification pipeline — host and actual ARM64 are separate
svg.desc: Cross-link alone is not execution; selected source equality is not full simulation parity.

g.text: Measured qualification pipeline — host and actual ARM64 are separate
Fixture hash enforced; unchanged selected bodies + explicit adapters; HOST Node oracle retained.
Three runs per engine; native 12/12; comparator 11/11; bounded adapter sanitizers.
Pinned ARM64 cross-link and private packages
Matching headers/libraries; ELF + provider versions + checksums; no libc/loader replacement.
One sequential run per engine, 300 blocks; aarch64 A55; glibc 2.44; ondemand governor.
Each engine: 85 selected leaves, seven checksum workload families, 19 protocol checks.
Cross-link alone is not execution; selected source equality is not full simulation parity.
